tooltips.theta: Estimated ability of the student according to Item Response Theory (IRT). Higher values indicate greater mastery.
tooltips.level: Overall proficiency level derived from the estimated ability.
tooltips.uncertainty: Standard error of the estimated ability. Lower values indicate a more reliable estimate.
tooltips.confidence: Confidence in the estimated ability. Lower uncertainty corresponds to higher confidence.
tooltips.progress: Difference between the first and latest estimated ability (Theta). Positive values indicate improvement.
tooltips.totalStudents: Total number of students enrolled in your courses.
tooltips.totalUsers: Total number of registered users on the platform.
tooltips.totalAnswers: Total number of answers submitted by students.
tooltips.averageTheta: Average estimated ability across all students.
tooltips.strugglingStudents: Students identified as needing additional support.
tooltips.averageScoreTeacher: Average score achieved by all students.
tooltips.averageScoreAdmin: Average score across all platform evaluations.
tooltips.accuracyTeacher: Overall percentage of correct student answers.
tooltips.modulesCompleted: Completed modules out of the total available.
tooltips.averageModuleProgress: Average completion percentage across all modules.

chartTooltips.thetaEvolution: Evolution of the estimated ability over time.
chartTooltips.weakTopics: Topics where the student has obtained the lowest performance.
chartTooltips.confidenceDistribution: Current confidence in the estimated ability derived from the uncertainty of the estimate.
chartTooltips.usersRole: Distribution of registered users by role.
chartTooltips.evaluationStatus: Distribution of evaluations according to their completion status.
chartTooltips.dropout: Distribution of students according to their predicted dropout risk.
chartTooltips.failedQuestions: Questions with the highest failure rates.
chartTooltips.cohorts: Distribution of students grouped by estimated proficiency.
chartTooltips.highRisk: Students currently identified as having the highest probability of dropout.
chartTooltips.moduleProgress: Percentage of completion achieved for each course module.
